body:
Recommendation was: a narrow first cut (core, SQL store, Hatchet adapter), then grow.

Decided by the owner 2026-10-10: narrower still. Hatchet as the main engine and an in-memory driver for tests; the SQL driver moves to later. About 1 to 2 weeks (2 to 4 with the SQL driver).
title: Decide: first-cut scope (narrow 3-4 weeks vs full P0+P1 6-9 weeks)
